variants.headline: State payments fall short
variants.body: State wages, unemployment benefit and pensions have all been paid short by the same share. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: Equal cuts, different household needs
variants.body: The government has underpaid wages, unemployment benefit and pensions, each by an equal proportion. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: Treasury pays less than it owes
variants.body: Government payments have fallen short across state wages, unemployment benefit and pensions alike. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.
